description: One data row of central/person_day.csv and person/{person_key}/person_day.csv, read as an object of column name to cell text; an empty cell is null. The header row must be exactly the columns of x-columns, in that order. Generated from meterline_gold/write.py and meterline_gold/dataset_docs.py by meterline_gold.contract; do not edit by hand. Meaning of each column: docs/reference/gold-datasets.md and the gold spec, sections 6 to 8. Retired names: schema_version 2.0 renamed a column (org_id is now provider_account_id).

actor_key.description: Keyed hash of the provider's actor id; empty for a resolved person with one account.

actor_kind.description: What the actor is: user, proxy user, end user, service account, API key or unassigned; mixed if merged records differ.

cost_ref.description: Reference cost of the row; empty when any merged record could not be priced.

cost_ref_status.description: How cost_ref was priced: priced, included, unpriced or unknown_model.

cost_source.description: Cost as the provider reports it, in cost_source_currency and on the cost_source_basis.

cost_source_basis.description: What cost_source is: billed, consumption or estimate; mixed if the rows differ.

credits.description: AI credits consumed, for providers that meter in credits.

identity_method.description: How the identity map matched the actor; mixed if merged records differ.

identity_status.description: How the actor was resolved: resolved, non_person or unresolved.

is_final.description: True when the provider will no longer revise the figure.

model.description: Model name as the provider reports it; empty when the record has none.

model_provider.description: Provider that served the model, when it differs from provider (a proxy such as litellm routes calls to a provider); mixed if the merged records differ; empty when the record does not say.

model_tier.description: Tier of the model in the price list, such as premium; empty for an unknown model.

person_key.description: Pseudonymous person key; empty when the actor is not resolved to a person.

product.description: Product within the provider; empty when the provider has none.

provider.description: Provider the usage or seats came from, as the silver records name it.

provider_account_id.description: Provider account label from the silver records; empty only where seats are matched on provider alone.

schema_version.description: GOLD_SCHEMA_VERSION of the build that wrote the file; the same on every row.

source_records.description: Number of silver records merged into the row.

tokens_cache_read.description: Input tokens read from a cache.

tokens_cache_write.description: Input tokens written to a cache.

tokens_input_total.description: All input tokens: uncached, cache read and cache write.

tokens_input_uncached.description: Input tokens not read from or written to a cache.

title: gold-dataset-person_day
x-cost-column-rule: `model_provider` is the provider that served the model, where a proxy routes calls on. Sum `cost_ref` to total or compare across providers and models: it prices every row from one price list in one currency, and is empty when a record could not be priced (see `cost_ref_status`). Sum `cost_source` only within one `cost_source_basis` and one `cost_source_currency`: billed, consumption and estimated amounts do not add up.
x-grain: One row per day, provider, provider account, person or actor, product and model.
